name: Slalom Skier
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 1, druid 1, magus 1, ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, summoner 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a miniature ski pole)

EFFECT

Range touch

Target creature touched

Duration 1 min./level

Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

The subject gains a +10 enhancement bonus on Acrobatics checks made to ski. The enhancement bonus increases to +20 at caster level 5, and to +30 (the maximum) at caster level 9.
